back_translation: Who has believed what we have heard? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

For he grew up before His presence like a tender shoot, and like a root piercing up from parched ground. He had no beautiful form or majesty to attract us, no appearance that would make us desire him.

He was despised and abandoned by people, a man of pain and well-acquainted with sickness. Like one from whom people hide their faces and refuse to look, he was despised, and we did not consider him of worth.
Truly, he took up the sicknesses of us all, and carried our pains; yet we considered him punished, beaten by God, and oppressed.
But he was pierced because of our transgressions, crushed because of our iniquities; the discipline that brought us peace fell upon him, and by his wounds we are healed.
We all have gone astray like sheep; each has turned to his own way, and the LORD laid the iniquity of us all upon him.
He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth. He was like a lamb led to the slaughter, and like a ewe silent before her shearers — he did not open his mouth at all.
He was taken away by coercion and judgment — and who can recount his descendants? For he was cut off from the land of the living; because of the transgression of my people the punishment fell on him.
He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and was with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, and there was no deceit in his mouth.

Yet the LORD willed to crush him and caused him to suffer sickness. When his life is made a guilt offering, he will see his offspring, he will live long, and the purpose of the LORD will succeed in his hand.
After the anguish of his life he will see the light of life and be satisfied. By his knowledge my righteous servant will make the many righteous, and he will bear their iniquities.

Therefore I will allot him a portion among the many, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death and was numbered with the transgressors — he bore the sin of many, and intercedes for the transgressors.
